purpose: Broad Phase-1 GA search for opportunistic long trading behavior during identified falling-bear/DEFENSIVE research windows, using DEV50 only.
window_note: Dates define retrospective research laboratories only; endpoints/troughs are never GA features and are not operational recovery gates.
candidate_source: Existing consumed discovery trajectory candidate signals. Phase 1 may search family, horizon, adverse-excursion/recovery entry geometry, confirmation timing, stop geometry and participation filters represented causally in those artifacts.
fitness: net trade expectancy after 10 bps round-trip cost
anti_overfit: penalize solutions dependent on one episode
interpretation: Phase 1 is discovery, not validation. Its purpose is to expose promising defensive-market trading structures for subsequent deterministic simulation and diagnostic TEST17.
